# SessionSense

> SessionSense is a free, open-source (MIT) Android app that tracks Claude and Codex usage limits in real time: the
> Claude Pro/Max/Team 5-hour session limit and weekly limit (also used by Claude Code), per-model Opus and Sonnet
> allowances, and Codex limits on ChatGPT plans. It has alerts before limits run out, a reset planner,
> usage history and home-screen widgets. It has no servers and no analytics; usage is read on the phone from claude.ai and
> chatgpt.com using the user's own sign-in.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android 8.0+ only. Not on the Play Store; installed as an APK from GitHub Releases and updates itself.
- Download: https://github.com/DevxD98/sessionsense/releases/latest/download/sessionsense.apk
- Accounts: up to 3 (Claude Pro, Max, Team; Codex via a ChatGPT account), switchable in one tap.
- Features: live 5-hour session ring with reset countdown; weekly quota with a pace insight; Opus/Sonnet limits;
  alerts at 60/30/10 minutes left, on reset and when weekly quota is tight, with quiet hours; planner (when the
  current window would hit its limit, notify-when-reset, Reserve mode to hold back part of the weekly limit);
  history of sessions and daily peaks; Glance home-screen widgets; Nothing Phone Glyph support.
- Privacy: no password is seen; only the session needed to read usage is stored, encrypted with the Android Keystore.
- Updates: verified by SHA-256 and signing certificate before installing.
- Stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Glance, Room, DataStore, WorkManager, OkHttp.
- Independent project; not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
